audience: pet boarding, daycare and grooming businesses that run on Gingr

useCases.title: See which pets are on site and today's arrivals
useCases.text: The AI lists the pets checked in now, today's arrivals and departures with owner and pet names, and the count of check-ins, check-outs and overnights.

useCases.title: List reservations for a period or cancelled ones
useCases.text: The AI lists boarding, daycare and grooming reservations between two dates, and the reservations that were cancelled recently.

useCases.title: Look up an owner, their pets and reservations
useCases.text: The AI finds an owner by name, email or phone and lists their pets and reservations, with the balance and contact details.

useCases.title: Check a pet's vaccinations, feeding and medications
useCases.text: The AI reads the immunization records with expiration dates, the feeding instructions and the medications of one pet.

useCases.title: Review invoices, estimates and package subscriptions
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices or estimates by date range, reads a point-of-sale transaction, and lists recurring subscriptions (packages).

useCases.title: Check staff hours on the timeclock
useCases.text: The AI reads the clock-ins, clock-outs and hours of staff at a location between two dates.
